probes.name: nietzschedice-modes
probes.query: what are the three modes of the nietzsche dice redesign

data.snippet: NietzscheDice becomes a local-first philosophical workspace with three modes: a Notebook where user uploads are indexed locally with grounded citations, a Quote Finder searching the full corpus with semantic and keyword matching over verbatim excerpts with source attribution, and a brainstorm mode.

probes.name: self-hosting-stack
probes.query: what stack does self-hosted praxis run on

data.snippet: Praxis is built with a local-first and data-sovereign philosophy: self-host the entire stack — PostgreSQL database, Node.js API, React PWA and local AI model — on your own hardware, VPS or home server with zero cloud dependencies.

probes.name: shared-objects
probes.query: what does sharing a link into praxis create

data.snippet: Sharing a link from another app is an implicit statement of interest: Praxis turns it into a durable fact — a canonical object, a user-to-object edge, and from repeated edges an affinity between two people who were never introduced.

probes.name: axiom-data-access
probes.query: does axiom read direct message content

data.snippet: Axiom reads tracker entries, note titles, public posts, goal names and check-in timestamps, but never direct messages: private conversations and confidential one-to-one discussions are excluded from its data access.
